project_info.theme: Toyota Innova Cross top sales in June
project_info.color_palette: Warm gold, bronze, white, city blue, charcoal

main_subject.detail: A dramatic sales-ranking poster with Toyota logo top left and large bronze headline 'TOYOTA INNOVA CROSS TOP DOANH SO THANG 6'. A white Toyota Innova Cross is parked in front of a glowing city backdrop. To the right is a giant golden number-1 trophy shape containing a family photo collage. Bottom text reads '1.670 XE DUOC BAN RA'.
main_subject.style: Premium sales-ranking poster with trophy symbolism, family-value inset, and glossy product-centered milestone communication

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / TOYOTA INNOVA CROSS / TOP / DOANH SO THANG 6 / 1.670 / XE DUOC BAN RA / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota logo and the bronze title block
Top Right: Glowing number-1 trophy panel containing a family moment collage
Bottom Left: White Toyota Innova Cross in front of a skyline and reflective ground
Bottom Right: Bottom metric line '1.670 XE DUOC BAN RA' and handwritten 'Move your world'
Center/Background: A city-glow milestone composition combining the Innova Cross hero car with the number-1 trophy visual

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Golden city glow, reflective car highlights, trophy-like prestige

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Innova Cross June top-sales milestone. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Innova Cross paired with a giant glowing number-1 trophy shape containing a family-life collage. Background is a warm city skyline with reflective ground and milestone lighting. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact title 'TOYOTA INNOVA CROSS TOP DOANH SO THANG 6', and bottom metric '1.670 XE DUOC BAN RA', plus the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal milestone automotive campaign composite, warm celebratory corporate lighting, golden glow and reflective highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
